adjudicated_statement: At (g,n)=(6,6), for a C66-TATE-SUPPORT artifact whose theorem_statement is the assigned unconditional theorem that the named C66-SUPPORT-INTERFACE subquotient T_Z of T:=W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(8), schema-population of target_interface_reference (nonempty interface_attempt_id, nonempty interface_claim_ids, correctly named target_subquotient and target_map_use, and nonempty survival_or_tate_argument) is not evidence that the target-interface artifact contract is met. The substantive test is the modality of the argument's conclusion: the named source, map, and subquotient must yield that assigned theorem with no undischarged hypothesis. A survival_or_tate_argument fails the contract, even when every named object is the genuine verified interface and no surrogate cohomology result is substituted, whenever it concludes the Tate type of this T_Z only under an antecedent that the same field lists as an open gap or that is equivalent to RED-0001 and is supplied by no verified artifact. Self-labelling as conditional, or naming a gap marker such as GAP-0122-1, is a sufficient witness of that failure when the labelled antecedent is undischarged; it is not an independent syntactic test, and it does not apply to a conditional whose hypothesis is independently verified and is not that undischarged campaign target. Candour that resolves_exact_target is false does not convert the conditional into the theorem. ATT-0122 is the witness: its interface_attempt_id ATT-0120, target_subquotient ker(r_T), and target_map_use phi are the genuine dual-confirmed ATT-0120 objects, yet survival_or_tate_argument is labelled Tate argument (conditional) and names GAP-0122-1. This statement does not assert that CLM-0122-1 is false: polarizable pure Q-Hodge structures of weight -16 form a semisimple abelian category, so T Tate implies T_Z Tate. It does not assert that RED-0001 is necessary for C66-TATE-SUPPORT. It does not identify this failure with surrogate substitution of family-base, atlas, product-model, or standalone-Z cohomology.
contradiction_resolution: Mandatory first reads of ATT-0122 and REV-0174 confirm the contested passage. ATT-0122 binds theorem_statement to the assigned unconditional C66-TATE-SUPPORT theorem (T_Z a finite direct sum of Q(8)) while populating every target_interface_reference slot with the genuine dual-confirmed ATT-0120 objects (interface_attempt_id ATT-0120; interface_claim_ids CLM-0120-1 through CLM-0120-7; target_subquotient ker(r_T) in image form; target_map_use the kernel inclusion phi). Its survival_or_tate_argument is labelled 'Tate argument (conditional, proved in CLM-0122-1)' and names GAP-0122-1, whose description is the RED-0001 hypothesis. REV-0174 independently failed TARGET-INTERFACE-REFERENCE on exactly that modality test, with verdict incomplete rather than refuted because resolves_exact_target is false. The candidate key word 'vacuously' is incorrect as a description of contract satisfaction: the contract is not met. The original disjunction 'self-labelled conditional, or whose text names a gap marker' is only a sufficient witness when the labelled antecedent is undischarged; it is not an independent syntactic test and would over-reject a conditional whose hypothesis is independently verified and is not the campaign target. No merge: FND-0057 is a different completeness-attestation inconsistency; FND-0054 is motive-upgrade; FND-0185 is the Gysin-free sufficiency lemma T_Z Tate if W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y) is Tate, marked not necessary, and is logically incomparable with RED-0001; FND-0033 supplies the semisimplicity that makes CLM-0122-1 true as a lemma. contradicts_claim_ids remains empty: CONJ-0001, THM-0001 through THM-0007, OBS-0001, and RED-0001 are compatible. Live primary check: Canning-Larson-Payne arXiv:2307.08830v3 / Forum Math. Pi 12 (2024) e23, Theorem 1.5 gives tautological generation of H_k(Mbar_{g,n}) only for even k<=14, and the same page states that Chenevier-Lannes predicts H^k isomorphic to a sum of L^{k/2} for k=16,18,20 while 'generation by algebraic cycle classes is an open problem' in those degrees; Conjecture 1.8 (Taut 20) remains a conjecture. Payne arXiv:2605.20453v1 records the same cutoff (homology even k<=14 known; Taut 20 conjectural). Hence GAP-0122-1 is genuinely undischarged. The same CLP text records that Hodge structures on smooth proper Deligne-Mumford stacks such as Mbar_{g,n} are semisimple, so the ATT-0122 implication is valid and is not the obstruction. Distinct from surrogate-substitution, which ATT-0122 does not commit.
